expectations.text: Recommends ERPNext Asset (and Asset Maintenance) as the primary approach for Equipment/Intervention, rather than building them as new custom dairy DocTypes.
expectations.evidence: without_skill/outputs/NOTES.md builds custom DocTypes as the primary solution ("What was created: Two DocTypes") and only mentions ERPNext Asset under "Architectural alternative (worth flagging before merge)" — i.e. an alternative, not the recommended/primary approach.

expectations.text: Explicitly cites that the spec's EQUIPMENT/INTERVENTION are ERPNext-core or not-built-by-design (the spec to implementation map / golden rule).
expectations.evidence: without_skill/outputs/NOTES.md contains no reference to the spec-to-implementation-map, golden rule, or any statement that EQUIPMENT/INTERVENTION are ERPNext-core/not-built-by-design. expectations.text: Does NOT present a from-scratch custom 'Equipement'/'Equipment' DocType as the recommended solution.
